name: Tsuyuzaki Chigusa
source:
The beautiful and intelligent vice-director of the hospital is the de facto leader in charge of running the hospital in place of the director, who spends all his time holed up in his lab.
Perhaps because she struggled financially to become a doctor when she was young, she treats the protagonist kindly.
However, it seems like there is something else behind her actions...

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916134742/http://www.silkys.jp/game/shitai/chara/tigusa.html]official website, archived[/url]]
